channel.title: RideMeme Digest — Philippine & world motoring
channel.description: The day's top Philippine and world motoring stories, auto-curated.

item.title: Honda Dream Cup closes 2026 season
item.description: The F.C.C. Honda Pilipinas Dream Cup concluded its 2026 season at Tarlac Circuit Hill, with 12 young riders competing in the fifth and final round of the motorcycle racing series.

item.title: Green GSM offers EV rentals, path to ownership
item.description: Green GSM has introduced an electric vehicle rental program in the Philippines that allows transport network vehicle service (TNVS) drivers to use VinFast cars for daily operations, with a possible path to ownership after five years.

item.title: Grid expectations
item.description: Three Filipino esports drivers will face former champions and some of the region’s top Gran Turismo 7 players when the TOYOTA GAZOO Racing Asia Esports GT Championship holds its 2026 finals in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, on 15 November.

item.title: Cool thoughts, beating the heat and driving with your dog
Kubota digs into construction
item.description: Kubota Philippines has entered the local construction equipment market with the launch of its U30-6S and U55-6S mini excavators, extending its business beyond agricultural machinery.

item.title: Maxim adds Butuan car rides
item.description: Residents and visitors in Butuan City can now book four-seater and six-seater car rides through Maxim Rides & Food Delivery, which has introduced new fares for its passenger transport service in the city.

item.title: Bentley’s golden dozen
item.description: A chance encounter on a French road in 1924 has become the unlikely link between Bentley’s latest limited-edition grand tourer and one of its earliest cars.

item.title: Audi lowers revenue forecast
item.description: German automaker Audi has lowered its financial forecast for 2026 after weaker sales in China and North America hurt its earnings during the first nine months of the year.

item.title: Flagship arrival
item.description: Lynk & Co has introduced its flagship SUV to Philippine buyers with the arrival of the 900, a six-seat plug-in hybrid priced at P4.28 million. The model made its local debut on 6 November at Sta. Elena Golf and Country Estate in Santa Rosa, Laguna.

item.title: Maserati Might Revive Two Familiar Names In December: Report
item.description: Maserati is reportedly prepping two concepts for a December 10 preview: the next Levante SUV and a radically new Quattroporte.

item.title: AI Comes For Drag Racers' Jobs As GM Patents Automated Launch Control
item.description: Pairing onboard cameras with existing launch control systems, this system could change the way you race at your local drag strip.

item.title: Lando Norris Wins Brazilian Grand Prix from Pole in Intense Mixed Conditions
item.description: Verstappen nearly grabbed a win from a new grid position, driving from 21st to second, but Lando Norris and McLaren made all the right decisions to keep Norris out front at the end.
